description: It's the annual Oxide and Friends tradition: Books in the Box! What books have the Oxide friends enjoyed? Didn't catch the show live, feel free to add your book recommendation as a PR in the show notes. In addition to Bryan Cantrill and Adam Leventhal, speakers included Tom Lyon, and Ian Grunert. Previously, on Oxide and Friends: OxF s01e16 - The Books in the Box OxF s02e18 - Books in the Box Redux OxF s03e22 - Books in the Box III OxF s04e28 - Books in the Box IV OxF s05e30 - Books in the Box V Recommendations from Bryan and Adam: Setting the Table by Danny Meyer Incorruptible by Eric Ries Steve Jobs in Exile by Geoffrey Cain The Power Law by Sebastian Mallaby Shoe Dog by Phil Knight Everything is Tuberculosis by John Green Need more? Phantom Plague by Vidya Krishnan American Poison by Daniel Stone The Morris Chang autobiography (in Chinese): Volume 1 and Volume 2 Apple in China by Patrick McGee Steve Jobs and the NeXT Big Thing by Randall Stross The Everything Store by Brad Stone Ter
title: Books in the Box VI
